references.text: Joshua received Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim as his inheritance, which he had requested. This is the same place as Timnath-Heres, where he was later buried.
This verse also describes Joshua's burial in Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash, and is a parallel account to Judges 2:9.
Joshua, son of Nun, from the tribe of Ephraim, is mentioned here as one of the leaders who were to distribute the land, linking him to the territory of Ephraim where he was later buried.
Joshua is first mentioned as a military leader who fought against the Amalekites, and this text shows the beginning of his service that culminated in his burial in his inherited land.
